title: Blue Hair in the Snow
prompt: An original young woman with long, electric blue hair dusted with snowflakes smiles warmly in a snowy forest. She wears a dusty blue sleeveless corset top with lace trim and long fingerless sleeves, layered with multiple dark necklaces and a silver pendant. A dark belt with a silver buckle sits at her waist. Her expression is joyful, with bright blue eyes. Falling snow and blurred evergreens behind her. Palette of cobalt, slate blue, and snow white. Playful and wintry, in the style of a cinematic fantasy film still.
workingNotes:
- The blue hair and snowfall are the defining elements.
- Keep the falling snow for a magical, wintry feel.
